decisions.reason: Changing the photograph selection on Page 42 does not alter the specified background treatment for the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, or last page.
The Page 42 photograph is distinct from the cover letter and its two overflow photographs.
The localized Page 42 photo-selection change does not modify the full-document layout approach or spacing rules.
Removing or substituting a photograph has no effect on font consistency or the unresolved bolding treatment.
The Page 42 photograph instruction does not change the Blue Mesa identity, logo, or color requirements.
The photo-selection revision does not affect Canva editing access, ownership, or asset licensing.
The Page 42 photograph change does not alter the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional.
The instruction concerns a photograph on Page 42 and does not change organization-chart inclusion or placement.
Changing one photograph does not alter required section content or resolve whether Section 11 belongs in the proposal.
Allowing a substitute photograph or one remaining photograph on Page 42 does not necessarily change the document page limit or spacing policy.
The Page 42 photograph instruction does not modify the supplied tables, budget sheet, or table replacements.
The photograph change does not affect the biography count, source, affiliation, or population method.
